description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error types observed in a study investigating generalization from atomic skills to complex reasoning tasks. The chart contains four slices, representing the categories “Atomic Skill Fail”, “Correct”, “Reason Error”, and “Question Misunderstood”. The “Atomic Skill Fail” slice is a dark teal color and occupies approximately 68.0% of the chart. The “Correct” slice is a lighter teal and represents 21.0% of the chart. “Reason Error” is a gray color and accounts for 10.0%, while “Question Misunderstood” is a light gray and represents 8.0% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A legend is provided, mapping each color to its corresponding error type. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest proportion and decreasing in size.
